exposure: timing of postprandial glucose monitoring (1h vs 2h)
cohort: Patients with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) who were referred to a medical center between July 2019 and June 2021.
finding: In patients with GDM, monitoring postprandial glucose 1 hour versus 2 hours following meals resulted in similar obstetrical and neonatal outcomes and similar satisfaction rates.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was similar between groups monitoring glucose 1 hour vs. 2 hours postprandial.
birth_weight: Average birth weight across both groups was approximately 3319g (3319 +- 355g vs. 3319 +- 520g).
gest_age: Not specified, but gestational age at delivery was similar between groups.
